components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action within a task region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.18); border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; background: #005fb8; font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,95,184,.9); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: rgba(0,95,184,.8); border-bottom-color: transparent; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005fb8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Standard Button
components.description: A familiar neutral action for secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-button-standard { height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.0578); border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.1622); border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.8956); background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-button-standard:hover { background: rgba(249,249,249,.5); } .ds-button-standard:active { background: rgba(249,249,249,.3); } .ds-button-standard:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005fb8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Card
components.description: A grouped settings surface with compact aligned rows.
components.css: .ds-settings-card { min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.0578); border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.1622); border-radius: 8px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.8956); background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-toggle { width: 40px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: #005fb8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The native-style field used to edit preset values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.6063); font: 12px/16px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.0578); border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.4458); border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.8956); background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field input:hover { background: rgba(249,249,249,.5); } .ds-field input:focus { border-bottom: 2px solid #005fb8; background: #fff; }

components.name: Hotkey Display
components.description: A readable keyboard shortcut using native keycap styling.
components.css: .ds-hotkey { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.4458); font: 12px/16px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-hotkey kbd { min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.0578); border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.1622); border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(0,0,0,.8956); background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font: 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: ResizeMe is one focused utility expressed through two native platform vocabularies. The Windows app follows WinUI-inspired density, controls, and tonal layering. The macOS app uses SwiftUI and AppKit conventions: semantic system colors, SF typography and symbols, standard menu-bar hierarchy, grouped forms, sidebar navigation, and platform materials. Cross-platform consistency comes from task order, language, and behavior, not identical pixels.
keyCharacteristics: WinUI-inspired settings on Windows; SwiftUI and AppKit conventions on macOS
Restrained accent use reserved for actions, selection, focus, and status
Compact but deliberate spacing that separates tasks without wasting room
Structural layering through surfaces and strokes rather than heavy shadows

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent color only for primary actions, current selection, active toggles, focus, and meaningful status. Inactive content stays neutral.

rules.name: The Adaptive macOS Rule
rules.body: Never replace SwiftUI semantic colors with fixed light-mode values. macOS surfaces must adapt to appearance, increased contrast, and the user's accent choice.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Use natural sentence case for section names, labels, and actions. Avoid repeated uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The Structural Elevation Rule
rules.body: Resting settings surfaces use borders and tonal layers; only overlays receive a shadow.

dos: Do group controls by the task users are trying to complete and give every section concise helper text.
Do reserve #005FB8 for Windows primary actions, selection, toggles, and focus.
Do use Color.accentColor and adaptive semantic styles in the native macOS app.
Do preserve a logical top-to-bottom keyboard order and visible :focus-visible treatment.
Do preserve standard macOS Settings, Quit, default-action, menu, and Accessibility permission conventions.
Do use 4px control corners, 8px surface corners, and the existing 4/8/12/16/24px spacing vocabulary.
donts: Don't create a dense control wall with weak hierarchy or make every option compete equally for attention.
Don't bury frequent tasks among unrelated controls.
Don't import Windows controls, dimensions, Segoe typography, or WinUI card styling into the native SwiftUI app.
Don't import macOS sidebar, menu, or SF Symbol conventions into the Windows Wails app.
Don't introduce decorative patterns that feel foreign to either platform, including glassmorphism, gradient text, or oversized marketing typography.
Don't hide required actions behind hover-only affordances.
Don't add colored side-stripe borders to cards, alerts, or list items.
